lucky-guy.en: Quick match loves him for RNG fun, and hunters hate his flare gun. High ranks once called him a slot-machine noob-trap, then a meta pick after April buffs, and an annoying tax after December nerfs.
lucky-guy.cn: 匹配娱乐之王，监管最恨的信号枪老六。高段位曾讥为抽奖混子，4月加强后成版本答案，12月削弱后又被嫌拖节奏。

doctor.en: Beginners love her as an angel and forgiving low-rank pick, while high ranks dismiss her as a tempo-less healbot. Veterans call her a classic noob-trap, Gardener-but-worse.
doctor.cn: 新手眼中的白衣天使、低段容错之王；高段却嫌她没节奏、只会补状态，是公认新手陷阱，老玩家戏称‘不如园丁’。

lawyer.en: Universally seen as a tutorial character. True beginners love him, ranked players mock him as a free hit and throw pick, and only his anti-terror niche is underrated.
lawyer.cn: 公认教学角色：萌新之友，排位路人眼中的混子/演员；仅免震慑救人有点小价值，其余被群嘲。

thief.en: A classic noob-trap and meme. Quick match loves his jumpscare stuns, ranked hates his decode debuff. Consensus: high effort, low reward, outclassed by every modern stunner.
thief.cn: 典型新手陷阱和整活角色：匹配爱他的惊吓晕眩，排位嫌他破译减速。公认高操作低收益，早被现代牵制位淘汰。

gardener.en: She is a beloved mascot and tutorial friend, but the community agrees she is a starter crutch. Beginners love her, high ranks pity her as safe, boring, and low-impact.
gardener.cn: 人气吉祥物、新手之友，但公认是新手拐杖。新手爱她，高阶嫌她：稳但无聊、作用低。

magician.en: An underrated solo-queue trickster. He is respected for outplay clips but dismissed as outdated against modern mobility. The community sees him as an honest, low-effort kiter, not OP, not a throw.
magician.cn: 被低估的单排魔术师：有高光但跟不上现代机动性。评价是诚实、低操作量的牵制位，不超模也不坑，非上分最优。

explorer.en: A beloved low-rank hide-and-seek troll, widely seen as a noob-trap and underpowered in high rank. After 2025-26 buffs he is an underrated fun pick, yet teammates still don't trust him.
explorer.cn: 低阶爱玩的躲猫猫整活角色，高阶普遍觉得是新手陷阱、强度低。2025-26连续加强后成了被低估的娱乐选，但队友仍不敢信。

mercenary.en: Universally respected as the best rescuer and a must-have. Teammates love him, hunters hate him as unkillable. He is seen as boring but reliable, with an obvious skill gap in pad play.
mercenary.cn: 公认第一救人位、必选角色，队友最爱、监管最恨的打不死小强。评价枯燥但可靠，护肘玩得好不好差距巨大。

coordinator.en: The Coordinator is a beloved beginner rescuer with a satisfying gunshot. Higher ranks see her as honest but one-dimensional and reliant on the Excitement check, while hunters find the gun annoying yet baitable.
coordinator.cn: 新手最喜欢的救人位，开枪那一下很爽。高阶觉得她老实但单一，全看兴奋博弈；监管觉得烦，但枪可骗可躲。

mechanic.en: The Mechanic is a respected S-tier decoder whom hunters hate and ban. She is the cipher-rush queen but a fragile liability once focused, and a noob trap if her doll is wasted early.
mechanic.cn: 她是公认T0修机位，屠夫必ban的修机头子。玩得好是爹，首追倒就是团灭发动机；新手容易开局卖娃。

forward.en: The Forward is loved when he clutches and hated when he feeds. Hunters find him annoying or toxic, while teammates respect skilled Forwards but fear low-tier ball-miss machines, and he is a classic high-ceiling showoff, not noob-friendly.
forward.cn: 救下来是英雄，撞空是演员。监管嫌恶心，队友又爱又怕：高端前锋是定心丸，低阶就是橄榄球失踪人口，属于天花板极高的秀操作角色，不新手友好。

the-minds-eye.en: The Mind's Eye is a classic noob trap and double-edged sword. Teammates groan at the lock-in, fearing an instant down, while hunters love a free win, and she is respected only as a one-trick A-badge grinder, underrated as info support after the 2025 buffs.
the-minds-eye.cn: 她是典型双刃剑/新人陷阱。秒锁盲女队友就叹气怕秒倒，监管则狂喜；只有专精A牌绝活哥受尊重，2025加强后报点辅助价值被低估但仍冷门。

priestess.en: The Priestess is a respected pro staple but divisive in ranked play: loved with voice chat, hated in solo when random portals feed the hunter. She has been nerfed the most yet remains top-tier, with a huge skill gap.
priestess.cn: 她是职业赛公认幻神，路人局口碑两极：开黑强无敌，野排乱打洞等于送。她被公认砍得最多却依然T0，上限下限差距极大。

perfumer.en: The Perfumer is a beloved, beginner-friendly kiter, though sometimes called boring or overrated. Hunters find her annoying but fair, while high ranks respect timing masters, and low ranks waste sprays.
perfumer.cn: 她是新手最爱、容错最高的溜鬼位，也被吐槽混子白板。监管觉得赖但可针对，高端看回香时机，低端乱喷秒没。

cowboy.en: The Cowboy is either a highlight hero or a thrower: a good Kevin is worshipped, while a bad one is a noob trap. Hunters hate him, and teammates fear random lassos exposing their position.
cowboy.cn: 牛仔两极分化最大：大神凯文是英雄，菜牛仔是演员，也是新人陷阱。他是监管最恨的救人位之一，队友怕被乱套暴露位置，是典型绝活哥角色。

female-dancer.en: The Female Dancer is a loved casual and low-rank staple: fun, pretty, and easy to feel useful. High ranks see her as an honest but outdated kiter whose slow aura annoys hunters, yet she is not ban-worthy and is overshadowed by Aeroplanist and Antiquarian.
female-dancer.cn: 她路人局火：好上手、好看、有趣、混能辅助。中高端觉得老实但过时，不超模也不弱，被飞行家/古董商压过，属情怀/绝活哥；监管觉得恶心但不值得ban。

seer.en: Seer is respected but divisive: teammates love a good one, hunters hate the owl for negating skills. He's a high-skill, high-trust pick, while noobs who stare at walls or donate owls are memes. In pro play, he's often called a ban-slot tax.
seer.cn: 先知风评两极：队友爱他的鸟，监管恨鸟抵消博弈。高端局是信任位，新手贪看鸟撞墙、白给鸟会被群嘲。职业赛常被称为ban位税。

embalmer.en: The Embalmer is a fashion-favorite underdog, loved for looks and lore, while hunters find rebirth annoying and time-wasting. The community calls him a noob-trap in low ranks—bad coffins throw games—but underrated in coordinated play.
embalmer.cn: 入殓师是颜值人气王，监管者最烦返生拖时间。评价两极：低阶局棺材位置差容易白给，高端开黑第二条命很香，属于被低估的棺材翻盘位。

prospector.en: Prospector is a respected meta kiter-support. Hunter mains find magnets annoying and overrated, but high-rank consensus is that he's strong when walls exist.
prospector.cn: 勘探员是高分局公认的强势牵制辅助；屠皇觉得磁铁恶心又有点被高估，有墙才是爹。

enchantress.en: Enchantress is a loved low-rank menace but seen as boring and a noob-trap higher up. Hunters hate her 4-second stun; survivors call her slow with low team value after nerfs.
enchantress.cn: 女巫是低阶恶霸、新手之友；高阶被嫌混子、没身位。屠皇恨4秒眩晕，削弱后求生者嫌她慢、团队价值低。

wildling.en: Wildling went from meme troll to respected anti-camp specialist. Teammates hate his decode burden in solo, hunters hate endless bump-blocking, and he's underrated in premade.
wildling.cn: 野人从混子逆袭为专治守椅的绝活；野排嫌他拖修机，屠夫恨撞人+挡路，开黑才香。

acrobat.en: Acrobat is a respected high-skill kiter, loved in montages but seen as a noob-trap in low ranks due to aim and bomb management. Hunters find sticky/fire zones annoying but punishable.
acrobat.cn: 杂技演员是高手向溜鬼位，观赏性强但低阶易空弹被视为坑；监管觉得黏土/燃烧弹恶心，但会绕开或远程克制。

first-officer.en: First Officer is loved by pros and rescue mains as a reliable, low-variance rescuer. Pubs call him boring and a selfish decoder-slave; hunters hate his guaranteed invulnerability, feeling it's uncounterable except by baiting the watch.
first-officer.cn: 大副是职业和高阶救人位最爱，稳定下限高；路人局嫌他无聊又拖电机；监管讨厌必救无伤，只能骗表拉出范围。

barmaid.en: Barmaid is loved as a sunny healer girl and underrated solo-carry in low-mid ranks. High rank calls her a decode-dragger; hunters bait her drink then chip. Pros see her as situational against poke comps.
barmaid.cn: 调酒师是人设讨喜的阳光奶妈，低中阶混子福音；高阶嫌她拖电机，监管骗酒再补碎血；职业仅特定磨血阵容才拿。

postman.en: Postman is a beloved casual pick thanks to Wick, and while underrated as a premade support, he is a solo noob-trap with slow value and a high game-sense tax. Hunters don't hate him, though the dog's slows annoy.
postman.cn: 邮差因威克被当休闲可爱选择，开黑辅助被低估，但野排是陷阱：增益慢、吃意识。监管不恨他，但烦狗减速。

grave-keeper.en: Grave Keeper is respected as the stable second rescuer after Mercenary. Low and mid tiers love his easy saves, while high and pro players see him as boring but reliable. Hunters find him honest, less tilting than Forward.
grave-keeper.cn: 守墓人是佣兵之下最稳的二救位，低中阶喜欢他救人简单，高阶和职业觉得朴实可靠。监管认为他老实，不像前锋那么招恨。

prisoner.en: Prisoner is a high-rank darling and scrim staple, but a low-rank noob-trap who feeds Terror Shocks and wastes links. Respected as brainy, he is blamed when link math throws off priming.
prisoner.cn: 囚徒是高阶和训练赛常客，低阶却是陷阱：容易吃震慑、乱连线。玩得好被夸有脑子，传错进度算错线就背锅。

entomologist.en: Entomologist is respected as an honest skill kiter and underrated after her 2025 buffs. Hunters find the swarm annoying but fair, and teammates love the free pushes. She isn't flashy and never gets S-tier hype.
entomologist.cn: 昆虫学者是口碑扎实的技术牵制位，2025年加强后仍被低估；监管觉得虫群烦但公平，队友喜欢免费推。不花哨，从没被吹成T0。

painter.en: Painter is a classic noob-trap and beginner-bait: oppressive in low tiers, frustrating and gimmicky in high tiers. Loved for his personality and art, he is hated by hunters as uninteractive and widely seen as overrated.
painter.cn: 画家是典型新手陷阱：低阶压迫感强，高阶刮痧、机制花哨让人难受。人设画风讨喜，监管嫌不互动，普遍认为被高估。

batter.en: Batter is loved by survivors and hated by hunters as a one-ball superman. High-rank consensus calls him a skillshot monster who is either game-winning or useless, widely seen as strong but fair after repeated nerfs.
batter.cn: 击球手是求生最爱的一球超人，监管最恨的角色；高阶共识是上下限极大的瞄准怪，要么带赢要么没用。多次削弱后仍被认为强但合理。

toy-merchant.en: Toy Merchant is respected as a high-IQ, underrated premade pick and annoying for hunters when mastered, but a solo noob-trap where catapults go to waste. Loved for fun flying, hated when bad placement feeds.
toy-merchant.cn: 玩具商被视为高智商开黑宝藏，玩得好监管很烦；野排是陷阱，弹射板车常白给。会飞很快乐，放错位置会被骂送。

psychologist.en: Psychologist is loved as a beginner-friendly girlfriend healer and lore couple with Patient. Hunters find her three-lives stalling annoying. Veterans call her overrated in high rank where heals get interrupted, though her mobility buff improved opinions.
psychologist.cn: 心理学家是新手最爱的女友型奶妈，和病患情侣人气高，被叫三条命混子；监管嫌拖时间。高阶认为连线易断偏高估，但加强位移后评价回暖。

patient.en: The Patient is loved as a fun Spider-Man-style rescuer with cool highlights, and after 2025 buffs he's seen as an underrated high-skill pick, though still a noob trap in low ranks where hooks miss. His couple lore is very popular.
patient.cn: 人气欢乐蜘蛛侠，集锦很帅但下限低。低阶钩不中就是白给，加强后高阶评价上升，仍不如佣兵稳定。嗑CP玩家最爱。

novelist.en: The Novelist is respected as a high-skill kiter and hated by hunters as a trickster. Casuals find him hard and feast-or-famine, while pros rate him a situational S-tier counter rather than a must-ban.
novelist.cn: 高分局认可的高上限溜鬼位，屠夫觉得他戏耍人很恶心。低分局觉得难玩、两极分化，定位是对策卡而非必ban。

little-girl.en: Little Girl is a divisive, underrated support: premades love her decode rush, but solo players hate leech Little Girls who attach and do nothing. Without comms she's a noob trap.
little-girl.cn: 口碑两极。开黑眼里是速修神器，野排眼里是混子代表，调侃说不是所有小女孩都混。没沟通就是陷阱。

weeping-clown.en: Weeping Clown is a loved casual fun pick and beginner-friendly rescuer. High ranks see him as a selfish decoder and underrated stuntman, while hunters find his rocket juke annoying but punishable.
weeping-clown.cn: 娱乐局快乐车头，新手友好救人位。高分局觉得他自私修机、特技被低估，会玩的炸晕很恶心，屠夫觉得烦但可针对。

professor.en: Professor is a niche, underrated duelist loved by timing masters but seen as a noob trap by others. Hunters find a well-played Professor annoying, yet generally prefer chasing him over Antiquarian or Forward because he's baitable.
professor.cn: 冷门被低估的单挑位，卡时机的高手很秀，其他人觉得是白给。屠夫觉得高手教授恶心，但相比古董商/前锋更愿意追他，骗鳞博弈收益高。

antiquarian.en: Antiquarian is consensus top-tier and one of hunters' most hated survivors, viewed as overpowered and annoying yet respected. She's a high ban priority in peak and tournaments, but noob-unfriendly due to aim and durability management.
antiquarian.cn: 公认T0，高分段和比赛热门ban位，也是屠夫最恨的角色之一。强度在线但上限高下限低，新手箫容易空、耐久秒没。

composer.en: Composer is respected as a boring but efficient rank climber. Solo players love free wins by hiding, hunters tunnel him first, and he's seen as a selfish decoder needing bodyguards. His 2026 kite buff remains unproven.
composer.cn: 又爱又恨的速修工具人。野排躲着修机上分爽，屠夫必首追。路人觉得他偏自私、需要队友保，2026加强牵制后评价回暖但仍非热门。

journalist.en: Journalist is loved by solo survivors as a beginner rescue god and basement savior, while hunters hate her risk-free rescues. High tiers call her honest but exploitable, outclassed by Mercenary and Coordinator.
journalist.cn: 路人局眼里的无伤救人神、地下室之光，屠夫眼里的无风险恶心角色。高阶觉得她下限高但上限中规中矩，稳定性不如佣兵、大副。

aeroplanist.en: Players see him as a fun, high-skill solo kiter with Patient-like potential but less team value. The community loves his highlights, dislikes the random direction and lag, and has dropped him from S to solid A since the distance nerf.
aeroplanist.cn: 路人眼中好玩的高操作单排溜鬼位，上限对标病患但团队价值低。随机方向和后摇被吐槽，2024削距离后从T0掉到扎实A。

cheerleader.en: Voice premades adore her as a meta-defining support, while hunters loathe her as a second-life machine. Solo players call her a frustrating noob-trap, since her value depends entirely on teammates using stacks.
cheerleader.cn: 开黑队伍视她为版本答案，也是前锋和击球手的最佳挂件。监管者嫌她是自起赖子。野排口碑两极分化，用不好就是混子陷阱。

puppeteer.en: He is loved as an honest, noob-friendly tank and safe rescue bot, though healer teammates dislike him. Ranked players see him as balanced-to-strong, boring but reliable, and not pro-meta after the chair nerf.
puppeteer.cn: 路人局口碑好的“肉盾救人位”，新手爱玩，医生系队友嫌弃。公认排位稳但不超模，2026椅旁削弱后比赛更少见。

fire-investigator.en: Players see him as a fun mid-tier trickster, underrated by casuals but respected by high-rank loopers. He isn't hated, though teammates complain when bags block them or decoding stays slow.
fire-investigator.cn: 路人觉得好玩但偏弱，高阶觉得封路很恶心。队友常吐槽气囊挡自己路、破译慢，整体中游有趣角色。

faro-lady.en: She is a divisive noob-trap or underrated trickster: casuals enjoy her but throw by rescuing, while high-rank mains love her outplays. The broad consensus is that she is a weak decoder who needs a rework and is too punishing.
faro-lady.cn: 争议大的“下水道欺诈位”，新手觉得好玩但救人坑队友，绝活哥能秀五台。主流评价：破译不赚、救人坐牢，呼吁重做。

knight.en: Solo-queue survivors love him as a noob-friendly rescuer, while hunter mains find his guessing-game annoying. The consensus is that he is strong but boring, slightly underrated after the nerf, and not ban-worthy.
knight.cn: 路人局喜欢他，救人稳、混子友好。屠夫嫌他恶心，猜拳玩法烦人。共识是救人T0但修机下水道，削后不超模，不值得ban。

meteorologist.en: She was considered overtuned on release, but after nerfs is now a respected high-skill S-tier. Survivors love her, while hunters call her gust-spam annoying. The consensus is that she is hard but worth mastering.
meteorologist.cn: 刚出超模被骂，连削后仍是S级牵制+辅助。路人觉得帅但难，屠夫觉得风恶心。共识是难精但练出来大腿。

archer.en: She was hyped as broken on release, but is now a divisive skillshot: high-rank shooters admire her, while low ranks call her a noob-trap. Hunters hate the delayed-stun mindgame.
archer.cn: 刚出被吹最强，削后评价分化：高手眼中T1射手，新手空箭陷阱。屠夫嫌延迟晕恶心，共识是上限高下限低。

escapologist.en: Escapologist is a respected niche rescuer who isn't hated. Low-rank players find the smoke confusing for both sides. High-rank players call it underrated anti-camping tech, though the decoding penalty holds him back.
escapologist.cn: 作为偏门救援位不招恨。低阶认为烟雾弹双向致盲，高阶认可其针对守椅是奇招，但修机debuff拖累强度。

lanternist.en: High-rank support mains love Lanternist, while hunters hate the time-freeze stall. Low-rank players see the character as overrated because mistimed cancels waste value, but she is S-tier in coordinated play.
lanternist.cn: 高阶辅助玩家喜爱，监管者嫌拖时间恶心。低阶因取消时机差视为花瓶，开黑体系中公认S级。

matador.en: Survivors universally love Matador, while hunters hate and ban him. He is seen as slightly over-tuned SS. High-rank players call him skill-expressive; low-rank players call him a brainless dash.
matador.cn: 求生者普遍喜爱，监管者视为必ban。高阶认为上限高、吃角度，低阶觉得无脑冲，普遍承认超模。

mime-artist.en: Mime Artist's elegant, eerie silent-film design is loved, but opinions split: a high-ceiling trickster for kite mains, a noob-trap for beginners due to the steep curve.
mime-artist.cn: 颜值与lore好评，强度有争议：会玩是口袋板区魔术师，不会玩是白板加破译debuff，新手劝退。

prodigy.en: Prodigy draws hype and skepticism: a cute rat-companion trickster with a suspected high ceiling, but only theory-craft so far. Players fear a noob-trap if aim or map knowledge fails.
prodigy.cn: 期待与观望并存：啮齿伙伴人设萌，共研评价认为操作上限高，但正式服反馈极少，担心成为新手陷阱。
